module_summary: UART receiver (8-bit) with oversampling/timing recovery using phase counter (ph) and token counter (tk), mid-bit sampling, and frame/parity error detection.

anchors.name: ph
anchors.why: Phase counter tracking bit position (0-10); controls receiver state and sample timing

anchors.name: tk
anchors.why: Token/timing counter for baud-rate synchronization and sample point timing

anchors.name: smp
anchors.why: Mid-bit sampled input register; captures rxd at sample point for bit detection

anchors.name: acc
anchors.why: Accumulator shifting in sampled bits; builds received byte from serial input

anchors.name: latch_q
anchors.why: Output latch holding received byte after frame completion

anchors.name: vq
anchors.why: Output valid flag; asserted when complete byte received, cleared by tready

anchors.name: rxd
anchors.why: Serial input data bit sampled into smp register

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output data port carrying received byte from latch_q

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid handshake driven by vq register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready signal; gates output valid and clears vq when data accepted

anchors.name: prescale
anchors.why: Baud rate prescaler input; configures timing reload values rl_long and rl_short

anchors.name: step
anchors.why: Timing step pulse when tk expired and ph active; gates state machine updates

anchors.name: tk_live
anchors.why: Token counter active flag; indicates timing in progress

anchors.name: ph_live
anchors.why: Phase counter active flag; indicates receiver actively processing bits

anchors.name: hdr
anchors.why: Header phase detector (ph > 9); classifies start/idle bits from data bits

anchors.name: mid
anchors.why: Mid-bit phase detector (ph > 1 and not hdr); gates accumulation during data phase

anchors.name: park
anchors.why: Parking state (no counters active); triggers receiver activation on start bit

anchors.name: fin_ok
anchors.why: Frame complete and valid; gates update of latch_q and vq on good reception

anchors.name: fin_bad
anchors.why: Frame complete with error; sets frame_error flag on bad stop bit

anchors.name: act
anchors.why: Busy/active flag output; indicates receiver is processing data

anchors.name: e_ov
anchors.why: Overrun error flag; set when new frame completes while previous data not read

anchors.name: e_fr
anchors.why: Frame error flag; set on invalid stop bit detection

groups.name: Timing_Control
groups.description: Phase and token counters driving sample points and state transitions

groups.name: Input_Sampler
groups.description: Mid-bit sampling pipeline capturing serial input at sample points

groups.name: Data_Accumulator
groups.description: Shift accumulator and output latch for received byte

groups.name: Output_Interface
groups.description: AXI Stream output interface with valid/ready handshake

groups.name: Phase_Control
groups.description: Phase decoders classifying header, mid, and tail bit positions

groups.name: State_Control
groups.description: State machine control flags: step pulse, park state, counter active indicators

groups.name: Status_Output
groups.description: Status and error flag outputs (busy, overrun, frame_error)
